name: EOD 2026-06-16
body:
> Eod · 2026-06-16

Tuesday overnight session (into 6/17). Google Search Console crawl and indexing pass across three sites.

# Pipeliners
See [Pipeliners (Hub)](lib:brain-pipeliners-hub).
- GSC: 72 indexed vs 275 not indexed. Only 171 truly "not yet indexed"; filtered to about 60 real pages after removing 54 leaked admin-ajax URLs, 26 feed URLs and archives. None of the 22 /service-areas/ city pages were indexed.
- Requested indexing on 13 service-area pages until "Quota Exceeded", confirming the manual cap is about 13 per property per day.
- Root cause: MetaSync (OTTO) virtual sitemap only crawls the top 100 pages (site has 106) and excludes Elementor-built pages. With approval, raised OTTO "Pages to Crawl" from 100 to 500.
- Flagged the popup plugin leaking `admin-ajax.php?action=pix_check_popup_status` URLs.

# Summit Plumbing Pros AZ
See [Summit Plumbing Pros AZ (Hub)](lib:brain-summit-plumbing-pros-az-hub).
- Healthy: 98 indexed, 16 not (12 intentional). Requested indexing on /expert-drain-line-services/ and /phoenix-plumbing/. Nothing pending.

# Alphalete Trenchless
See [Alphalete Trenchless (Hub)](lib:brain-alphalete-trenchless-hub).
- Discovered the site was rebuilt: 23 of 26 "Crawled, not indexed" URLs now 404. New Yoast build has about 227 pages and retargets Colorado Springs.
- GSC had only the old `/sitemap.xml` (now 301, 0 pages). Submitted the new `sitemap_index.xml`.
- Added 22 old-to-new 301 redirects in `.htaccess` (backup `.htaccess.bak-2026-06-16`), all verified.

# Other
- Installed the `web3-premium-website-generator` skill at user level.
- GSC properties on the account: pipelinersusa.com, summitplumbingpros.com, alphaletetrenchless.com, summitplumbingut.com, tagmktg.com.

# Follow-ups
- Pipeliners: keep about 13 index requests per day; verify the OTTO 500-page crawl picked up city pages in about 3 days; open a Search Atlas ticket on the Elementor exclusion; block admin-ajax URLs in robots.txt.
- Alphalete: not-indexed pass on new pages once processed; remove stale old sitemap from GSC.
